name: Lake Abbe
story: Lake Abbe is a salt lake lying on the Ethiopia-Djibouti border. It is the ultimate destination of the Awash River, at the center of the Afar Depression, and is known for its flamingos and steam-spewing limestone chimneys.
matters: The lake is part of a chain of six connected lakes and belongs to the wetland ecosystem of Djibouti, which includes large lakes and salt pans.
